source: “The MLP mixes tokens.” It acts position-wise; context can already be present in each state. “ZXNAME0000XZ is ZXNAME0001XZ without bias.” ZXNAME0002XZ also omits mean subtraction and uses a different scale statistic. “Pre-LN and Post-LN are equivalent reorderings.” They define different computation/gradient paths. “RoPE modifies token embeddings.” Standard RoPE rotates Q/K inside attention. “Every modern ZXNAME0003XZ is Pre-ZXNAME0004XZ + ZXNAME0005XZ.”
zh: “MLP 混合了代币。”它按位置行事；上下文可能已经存在于每个状态中。 “ZXNAME0000XZ 就是 ZXNAME0001XZ，没有偏见。” ZXNAME0002XZ 还省略了均值减法并使用不同的尺度统计量。 “LN 之前和 LN 后是等效的重新排序。”他们定义了不同的计算/梯度路径。 “RoPE 修改了令牌嵌入。”标准 RoPE 在注意力内旋转 Q/K。 “每个现代 ZXNAME0003XZ 都是 Pre-ZXNAME0004XZ + ZXNAME0005XZ。”
